meta.purpose: A transparent, versioned correction layer for verse-level text-integrity comparison ONLY. Applied by scripts/checksum-verify-full-options.js when reconstructing verse text for comparison against Tanzil. Never applied to, and never mutates, data/raw/uthmani.json -- that file is third-party licensed source data (see data/LICENSES.md) and is not edited by this project.
meta.corroboration: Each correction was independently confirmed against two sources: a real Tanzil download (data/external/tanzil-uthmani-full-options.xml) and a live fetch from the quran.com v4 API (api.quran.com/api/v4/quran/verses/uthmani). Both agree with the corrected form in every case below.
meta.policy: Only formatting-class differences (extra/missing whitespace, stray bidi control characters) are corrected here. The two orthographic-class differences (11:13, 80:25) are deliberately NOT included -- see data/external/qul-orthographic-review.md.

5:52.rawText: فَتَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِيهِمْ يَقُولُونَ نَخْشَىٰٓ أَن تُصِيبَنَا دَآئِرَ ةٌۭ ۚ فَعَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَأْتِىَ بِٱلْفَتْحِ أَوْ أَمْرٍۢ مِّنْ عِندِهِۦ فَيُصْبِحُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَسَرُّوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ نَـٰدِمِينَ
5:52.correctedText: فَتَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِيهِمْ يَقُولُونَ نَخْشَىٰٓ أَن تُصِيبَنَا دَآئِرَةٌۭ ۚ فَعَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَأْتِىَ بِٱلْفَتْحِ أَوْ أَمْرٍۢ مِّنْ عِندِهِۦ فَيُصْبِحُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَسَرُّوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ نَـٰدِمِينَ
5:52.note: دَآئِرَ ةٌۭ -> دَآئِرَةٌۭ (removed the space splitting one word into two tokens).
